summary: Add an authorized get-by-id lookup for an existing soft-hold so operators and client tests can confirm hold state: authorized opaque principals receive hold details; missing or not-visible holds and unauthorized callers fail with named domain errors without mutating stock or holds; extend OpenAPI, UML OCL, and Vitest additively while keeping prior reserve/release/expire behavior and excluding payments, multi-warehouse, full IAM, UI, notifications, TTL extend, and list-by-SKU aggregates.
goal: Authorized callers can look up an existing soft-hold by id and receive its details; missing/not-visible and unauthorized lookups fail with named domain errors without mutation; OpenAPI, OCL, and Vitest make the lookup behaviors machine-checkable without breaking prior reserve/release/expire surfaces.
background: Follow-on to done change initial-reservation. Callers can soft-hold, release, and expire holds but cannot read an existing soft-hold by id. Demand, inherited TypeScript/Node + OpenAPI + OCL + Vitest stack, and out-of-scope themes were settled in Change Context.

in_scope.text: WHEN an authorized opaque principal looks up an existing visible soft-hold by id THEN THE reservation service SHALL return that hold's details without mutating stock or holds
IF the soft-hold does not exist or is not visible THEN THE reservation service SHALL fail lookup with a named domain error and leave stock and holds unchanged
IF the caller is unauthorized THEN THE reservation service SHALL fail lookup with a named domain error and leave stock and holds unchanged
Additive HTTP/API surface in OpenAPI that exposes get-by-id soft-hold lookup clients and tests can exercise without removing prior reserve/release/expire operations
Module-level UML OCL contracts with derived Vitest tests that make authorized get-by-id success and named missing/not-visible and unauthorized lookup failures checkable

out_of_scope.text: Multi-warehouse routing or cross-location inventory allocation
Full IAM product (SSO, OAuth UI, role admin) beyond opaque-principal authorize/deny for this sample
Notifications (email, push, webhooks) about holds or expiry
Backorders, waitlists, or deferred fulfillment beyond hard-fail when stock is below request
Durable shared persistence across process restarts beyond in-process stock and holds
Formal methods (e.g. TLA+) for concurrent hold races or distributed consistency
TTL extend or renewal of an existing soft-hold
List-by-SKU, aggregates, or other multi-hold query surfaces beyond get-by-id

assumptions: Prior Features at requirements/reservation.feature remain in force; this change does not rewrite reserve/release/expire Scenarios
AuthZ for lookup mirrors the existing opaque-principal allow/deny pattern; exact wire format stays deferred to OpenAPI apply
Exact HTTP path/method shape for lookup (e.g. GET /reservations/{id}) is deferred to OpenAPI apply; behavior is get-by-id
Missing and not-visible holds share one named domain error unless a later apply narrows visibility (e.g. expired-hold visibility)
Error JSON / status codes for the new named domain error are deferred to OpenAPI apply; the named error itself is required
Stock and holds remain process-local / in-memory; no new persistence model
constraints: OpenAPI SoT path: openapi/openapi.yaml (additive lookup only; do not break prior reserve/release/expire surface)
UML OCL under contracts/**/*.ocl; derived Vitest under tests/contracts/**
Missing/not-visible and unauthorized lookup failures must use named domain errors shared by API, OCL, and tests
Contract kind and density choices are deferred to solidsdd-judge; this brief only requires checkable HTTP/API and module surfaces for lookup
ChangeBrief only at this step: no Feature files, WorkPlan, OpenAPI, OCL, tests, or implementation edits as part of brief emission

success_criteria.text: WHEN an authorized opaque principal looks up an existing visible soft-hold by id THEN the service returns that hold's details without mutating stock or holds
IF the soft-hold does not exist or is not visible THEN lookup fails with a named domain error and leaves stock and holds unchanged
IF the caller is unauthorized THEN lookup fails with a named domain error and never mutates stock or holds

openapi/openapi.yaml documents additive lookup while prior reserve/release/expire operations remain; contracts/**/*.ocl and passing tests/contracts/** cover get-by-id success and named missing/unauthorized failures

open_questions: Exact HTTP path/method for lookup (deferred to OpenAPI apply; non-blocking)
Whether expired holds are not-visible vs a distinct named failure (default: same named missing/not-visible error; non-blocking)
Error JSON / HTTP status mapping for the new named domain error (deferred to OpenAPI apply; non-blocking)

human_gate.reason: Demand (authorized get-by-id + named missing/not-visible and unauthorized errors), inherited stack, and out-of-scope themes including TTL extend and list-by-SKU were settled in Change Context; open_questions are non-blocking deferrals to OpenAPI/OCL apply.
